summary: To run behind a reverse proxy or load balancer, add HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR, REMOTE_ADDR and REMOTE_HOST to Remote Host Headers (Settings > Automation Execution > System) and set USE_X_FORWARDED_PORT and USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST to True in /etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py.
questions: How do I configure automation controller behind a reverse proxy?
Where do I set Remote Host Headers for X-Forwarded-For?
Controller shows the load balancer IP instead of the client IP

answer_card.title: Reverse proxy / load balancer headers
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **Settings > Automation Execution > System** > *Remote Host Headers*:
```json
["HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR", "REMOTE_ADDR", "REMOTE_HOST"]
```
2. Add to `/etc/tower/conf.d/custom.py`:
```python
USE_X_FORWARDED_PORT = True
USE_X_FORWARDED_HOST = True
```
3. Save.
